results.name: $policy says 'fails at base' and not 'fails identically at base' as the claim
results.detail: Every entry is pre-existing test rot: its test exists at the register's base commit (at basePath when S-OS-06's codemod renamed it) and FAILS there (exit code non-zero). `node scripts/checks/run-tests.js --verify-base` checks both. The policy says FAILS AT BASE, not fails IDENTICALLY at base: the codemod rewrote text inside SP-20260616-001/wrapper-door's own cause line (WARPOS_SHAPE_DOOR became MC_SHAPE_DOOR), so the rename touched its own evidence and the stronger claim cannot hold for all entries. A test absent at base (sprint-authored) cannot enter. The runner runs each quarantined file alone and FAILS if it passes (remove the entry), is missing, is not at base, or fails with a different multiset of cause lines or more failing tests than registered. Never add a file to green a red run: fix it, or file it here with its observed cause lines, cause, filing and expiry.
